title: PAHO dengue source-feasibility search and inspection log
scope: Queries and accesses actually performed by the PAHO source investigator for this atlas. This is not an exhaustive project search log or systematic literature review.

queries.query: site.paho.org dengue data PLISA download Colombia weekly cases data
queries.purpose: Locate official dengue data and downloads.

queries.query: site.paho.org dengue indicators csv Colombia department
site.help.tableau.com export csv views sheet parameter dashboard

queries.purpose: Identify the official Colombia dashboard workbook context.

inspected_resources.title: Dengue indicators, PLISA
inspected_resources.access: Web fetch returned 403; direct HTTP retrieval succeeded and HTML was inspected.
inspected_resources.finding: Weekly national surveillance description, legacy subnational menu, and CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO footer. Legacy menu omits Colombia.

inspected_resources.title: ARBO Portal
inspected_resources.access: Web fetch returned 403; direct HTTP retrieval succeeded and HTML was inspected.
inspected_resources.finding: Data are preliminary and may increase or decrease during national validation; a newer Colombia country profile exists.

inspected_resources.title: Colombia country profile
inspected_resources.access: Direct HTTP HTML retrieved and inspected.
inspected_resources.finding: Embeds the official Colombia Tableau dashboard wrapper.

inspected_resources.title: Dengue data and analysis
inspected_resources.access: Direct HTTP HTML retrieved and inspected.
inspected_resources.finding: Regional dengue surveillance description and regional dashboard wrapper.

inspected_resources.title: Terms and conditions of use of the site
inspected_resources.access: Direct HTTP HTML retrieved and inspected.
inspected_resources.finding: Attribution and endorsement limits; source resources may have distinct rights.

inspected_resources.title: Colombia dashboard wrapper
inspected_resources.access: Direct HTTP retrieval and public embedded Tableau session inspection. Temporary public-view tickets are deliberately not retained in this log.
inspected_resources.finding: Visible aggregates inspected: 668 national weekly rows, 104 national indicator rows, 32 departmental map rows, one latest-week indicator. Historical departmental panel semantics were not established.

inspected_resources.title: Colombia Tableau summary view
inspected_resources.access: Opened through the official public wrapper. Read-only tableauscraper extraction of visible aggregate worksheets.
inspected_resources.finding: New Suspected Cases weekly field; no person-level fields requested. Nonpublished dashboard navigation did not establish additional historical departmental data.

inspected_resources.title: Colombia dashboard-level CSV
inspected_resources.access: Unsessioned request returned 403; request within the official wrapper public session returned CSV.
inspected_resources.finding: Export contained only the latest-week worksheet (2026, week 41), not the complete dashboard dataset.

inspected_resources.title: Regional dengue dashboard wrapper
inspected_resources.access: Direct HTTP wrapper HTML retrieved and inspected.
inspected_resources.finding: Links to regional Tableau workbook 1001en; regional observations were not extracted for production use.

inspected_resources.title: Download Views and Workbooks
inspected_resources.access: Official search-result excerpt inspected; no full-page retrieval claimed.
inspected_resources.finding: Dashboard downloads require selecting the intended worksheet.

inspected_resources.title: Workbooks and Views Methods
inspected_resources.access: Official search-result excerpt inspected; no full-page retrieval claimed.
inspected_resources.finding: A dashboard CSV request can return the first view only.

decision: Use PAHO for contextual source assessment only. No PAHO observations are combined with or redistributed in the atlas.
limitations: Searches were targeted and not exhaustive.
No final historical department-level PAHO export contract was verified.
Date basis, district inclusion, and rate denominator semantics remain unresolved for the inspected PAHO map.
INS and DANE retrieval evidence is maintained separately in their source manifests and assessments.
